scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run dev
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run build
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run test
scripts.test:api:db: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run test:db
scripts.verify:api: npm run test:shared && npm run build:api && npm run test:api && npx prisma validate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.dev-login: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace backend run dev-login --
